snippet.title: DATA DUTY | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Congratulations on your new position as Chief Technology Officer of Dubitably Data! Learn about cybersecurity as you survive cyber-based disasters, complete objectives, explore, and interact with the custom 3D office environment! All in a fun little indie game!

————————————————————————————

Check out DATA DUTY on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3953070/DATA_DUTY/

————————————————————————————

Gameplay was captured using the following hardware:
CPU: AMD Ryzen 9 5900X
GPU: AMD Radeon RX 7900 GRE
RAM: 32GB (2x16GB) DDR4 @3200mhz
Resolution: 2560x1440p 180 FPS
OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
Storage: 2TB SSD

The hardware listed is not representative of the hardware requirements to run the game. This list is for transparency. For more information regarding DATA DUTY's hardware requirements, visit the Steam page linked above in the Wishlist DATA DUTY Section.
